title: Digoxin Immune Fab (DigiFab) — Vial Dosing
keywords: vials = serum digoxin ng/mL times weight kg divided by 100
vials = mg ingested times 0.8 divided by 0.5
empiric acute 10 to 20 vials chronic 3 to 6 vials
each 40 mg vial binds 0.5 mg digoxin
sources: Goldfrank's Toxicologic Emergencies, 11th ed. — Cardioactive Steroids; Antidotes in Depth: Digoxin-Specific Antibody Fragments
Lavonas EJ, et al. 2023 AHA Focused Update on Management of Cardiac Arrest / Life-Threatening Toxicity Due to Poisoning. Circulation. 2023;148(16):e149-e184
Chan BS, Buckley NA. Digoxin-specific antibody fragments in the treatment of digoxin toxicity. Clin Toxicol. 2014;52(8):824-836

changelog.change: Initial entry — vial estimates from a steady-state serum digoxin level, from a known ingested amount, or empiric; companion to the digoxin section of tox-cardiac-meds.

purpose: Estimates the number of digoxin immune Fab (DigiFab) vials. Fill in whichever you have — a steady-state serum digoxin concentration (drawn ≥ 6 h post-dose) with weight, OR the total amount ingested. If neither is known, use the empiric figures in the notes. Each 40 mg vial binds ~0.5 mg of digoxin.

inputs.label: Serum digoxin concentration (steady state, ≥ 6 h post-dose)

formulas.label: Vials — from serum level + weight (already rounded up)
Vials — from amount ingested (already rounded up)

interpretation.label: Reconstitute and give IV over ~30 min (bolus if peri-arrest). After Fab, total serum digoxin levels are UNINTERPRETABLE for days (the assay measures bound + free) — dose by clinical response, not a repeat level.

notes: Empiric dosing when neither a reliable level nor ingested amount is available: acute overdose in an adult or child — 10-20 vials (start 10, repeat if incomplete response); chronic toxicity in an adult — 3-6 vials; chronic toxicity in a child — 1-2 vials and titrate. INDICATIONS for Fab (not this calculator's output): potassium > 5 mEq/L in acute toxicity, any life-threatening dysrhythmia or haemodynamic instability, acute ingestion > 10 mg (adult) or > 4 mg (child), or steady-state level > 15 ng/mL (or > 10 with symptoms). Also effective for digitoxin and plant/animal cardiac glycosides (oleander, toad venom) though more vials may be needed. Treat hyperkalaemia WITH Fab; IV calcium is traditionally avoided in digoxin toxicity. Dialysis does not remove digoxin. See `tox-cardiac-meds`.
buildNote: Formula engine — the two estimate methods are independent formulas that each appear only once their inputs are filled (weight+level, or ingestedMg); each shows a ceil()-rounded whole-vial figure plus the unrounded basis. Empiric figures and the indications for giving Fab live in notes, not as computed outputs.
